data.one_liner: URL-based Flutter downloader with batch support and automatic file management
data.what_it_does: Allows downloading any type of file by URL using flutter_downloader under the hood. Automatically manages files and tasks without requiring a specified download path, and supports batch downloads.
use_when: You need to download files from URLs in a Flutter application.
You want automatic local file management without manual path specification.
avoid_when: You need complex network operations beyond simple file downloading.
You do not want native platform configurations required by flutter_downloader.
strengths: Supports batch downloads of multiple files.
Automatically manages files and storage paths.
Provides convenient download status handlers and interfaces.
weaknesses: Requires native configuration setup via flutter_downloader.
Relies on external native downloader dependencies.
data.setup_notes: Native configuration is required, matching the setup steps of the underlying flutter_downloader package for Android and iOS.
